design.metric: mean of |v(+10)-v(0)| and |v(-10)-v(0)| over 10 degrees; relative to v(0) for lengths and ratios, absolute degrees for angles. This matches how cosine_yaw_sensitivity() builds the a-priori value.
design.roll_control: each measurement in roll_claims is swept a second time in the frame-referenced form the catalogue used before the roll defect was found; that twin must move, or a zero slope proves nothing
